data.title: 喜多川海梦 · 放学后的服装设计本
data.description: 【喜多川海梦 · 放学后的服装设计本】放学后的教室安静下来，海梦还穿着敞开西装外套、系着宽松领带的校服，坐在窗边摊开服装设计本。她用一根手指压住纸页，另一只手拿着铅笔修改袖口的小花边，笑着把新想法指给你看——「先把这里画清楚，做衣服的时候就不会搞错啦！」
data.action: 坐在课桌前，一手压住设计本，另一手用铅笔修改服装草图
data.promptProse: After class, Marin sits at a desk in her school uniform, her blazer open and her tie loose, holding a sketchbook flat with one hand while the other pencils a revised cuff onto a costume design. Slanting afternoon sunlight crosses the desk and the empty classroom behind her, lighting the fabric swatches beside the book as she smiles at her new idea.
data.camera: medium shot, seated at a classroom desk with sketchbook and both hands visible
data.lighting: 斜照在课桌上的午后窗光
